facts.statement: The entry treats a leading configuration struct as options and width, then uses the remaining bytes as Markdown. Mode 0 calls cmark_parse_document; modes 1 and 2 use file and incremental parsing; mode 3 calls cmark_markdown_to_html.
The harness masks options to the listed CMARK_OPT bits, including CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8. An all-zero configuration header selects mode 0 with options and width zero.
The supplied recipe builds cmark_static with CMake, compiles fuzz/cmark-fuzz.c, and links it with libcmark.a into cmark_fuzzer.

On both source versions, open_new_blocks tries the type 7 scanner only when the line is not indented, the container is not a paragraph, and maybe_lazy is false. A successful match creates an HTML block and stores the returned block type.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the container, laziness and indentation state used by the scanner gate.

facts.statement: The before type 7 scanner has a path for a valid two-byte UTF-8 sequence inside a double-quoted attribute value: a lead byte from C2–DF followed by a continuation byte returns to the quoted-value state. A closing quote, `>`, and line ending can then produce return value 7.

The after scanner's byte map marks bytes 80–FF with value 224, which includes the quoted-value loop's bit 64. Thus a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 attribute value can pass through the double-quoted path; a closing quote, `>`, and line ending can still produce return value 7. The changed scanner does not itself establish the claimed missed block start for this condition.

The harness supplies the same Markdown bytes through document, file, incremental parser, or Markdown-to-HTML routes selected by the configuration's upper bits; these are alternate target call sequences for reaching parsing behavior.
The complete harness contains no assertion about HTML block recognition or rendered content. It checks whether doc is non-NULL before rendering, then frees each render result without inspecting it.

missing_information: For an unconditional end-to-end reachability claim, supply before and after src/blocks.c definitions of cmark_parse_document, S_parser_feed, and S_process_line, plus the src/scanners.h definition of scan_html_block_start_7. These establish how the input reaches the scanner and how its result is interpreted.
